Talk about some UNUSUAL November weather... Buffalo, New York is WARMER than Dallas, Texas!

Buffalo reached 78°F today, while Dallas has only climbed to 75°F!

That 78°F reading in Buffalo is a preliminary RECORD HIGH for November 4th.

Not exactly the temperatures you'd expect https://t.co/1JahDbdRAE

More than 160 people have been rescued following a historic 1-IN-1,000-YEAR rainfall event.
